digest.component_or_area: review-bot ticket store clone and autodeploy
propositions: The review-bot's persistent tickets clone on EBS volume is not refreshed on redeploy because the entrypoint only clones when .git is absent, leaving divergent history in place.
The ensure-tickets.sh script must fetch and converge the clone to the remote state but currently does not, leaving local-only commits when the bot writes after Gerrit votes.
The ensure-script convergence must be invoked outside the PAT block so it runs even when REVIEWBOT_TICKETS_PAT is unset.
The autodeploy.sh script does not include reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh in BOT_PATHS, preventing changes to that script from triggering a redeploy.

Convergence must use the existing reconverge path for compatible stores and offer a narrow reclaim adoption path only for pre-epoch clones whose local tip is an ancestor of a readable prior remote tip.
Convergence failures must remain best-effort and must never undo an already-cast vote or wedge the review-bot vote emission path.
